meta_description:
16K likes, 147 comments - thefitnesschef_ on October 26, 2026: "You need to try this sensational Crispy Chicken Parma Wrap 🌯

Ingredients:
150g chicken breast
1 large tortilla wrap
5ml olive oil 
1 tsp smoked paprika
1 tsp Garlic powder
1 tsp Onion powder
1 tsp Chilli powder 
Salt
Pepper
Juice of 1/4 lemon
1/2 chopped onion
20g parmesan 
Fresh parsley
3 chopped iceberg lettuce leaves
Dipping sauce:
50g natural yogurt
1 tsp Dijon mustard
5g parmesan 
1/2 tsp smoked paprika
Juice of 1/4 lemon

Method:
1. Add the chicken breast, olive oil and seasoning to a large mixing bowl. Mix well with hands
2. Add to a non stick pan and cook for 3 mins
3. Add the Parmesan and onion and cook for further 7-8 mins
4. Meanwhile, make the dipping sauce by adding all ingredients and mixing thoroughly
5. Assemble the wrap by adding the lettuce to the centre, followed by the chicken, the folding 
6. Add to the same pan and crispen each side for 1-2 mins
7. Wrap bottom half of wrap in foil to hold together and serve

Nutrition information:
Calories: 524
Protein: 53g
Carbs: 42g
Fat: 16g
Fibre: 5g

Thanks to @iramsfoodstory for this outstanding recipe!

#recipeideas #fatloss #crispychicken".
